book: Agrawal ExamCart, SSB OIR, Reasoning section
scans: SSR OIR 1-127 (phone photos of printed pages 1-127)
title: Mirror and Water Images
note: Only questions printed as text (letters, digits, arrows and triangles) are transcribed in full; drawn figures that are redrawn carry `figure` (the question drawing) and `answerPanels` with one `figure` per option, in the frame units (each box drawn 100 by 100: option boxes are printed narrower than question boxes and their drawings squeezed with them); the rest carry a one-line description and are held. A text question's options are stored twice: `answerPanels` holds each option glyph by glyph as printed, left to right, each glyph plain, flipped left to right (x), upside down (y) or turned half round (xy); `options` says the same in words for screen readers. Each glyph is written as the character of the question it stands for, with the flip that draws its printed shape. Where two flips draw the same shape for that character, the simpler is written: plain for a symmetric letter (A, O, T...), across rather than upside down for 3, B, C, D, E, K, and plain for N or S turned half round. Readings at the limit of the photos: Q12 A prints an undotted l where C prints i (the only difference between them). Q22 D's 1 shows no flag on its left, read as flipped. Q59: A, B and D print a serifed I where C prints a 1 upside down; A and B read the same glyph for glyph and differ in spacing only. Q37: the small a's left-right turn cannot be seen in the photo; it is read as flipped across in options A and D. Q27 A, B and D read the same glyph for glyph. Q24 B lies on the curve of the page. Q38: the B is read reversed in B and D and plain in A and C, at 22 times zoom. Q54 and Q58 B end in a round O that may be a zero; both look the same upside down. Q13 draws MN as a vertical mirror on the right, but its options are water images. Q58 B prints Q54's series in place of an image of SHARE. Q53 prints SEARCH in a frame shaped like an arrow, which is not transcribed. Q31 is a grid of letters and is held as a figure. Q55-57 print options (A) (a), (B) (b), (C) (d), (D) (d) under four figures a-d: options C and D are both figure d, and figure c is offered by no option; C and D are stored as the same drawing. Q49 and Q69: the option drawings are the question groups turned (as read, half round, left to right, upside down) and placed, each checked on its overlay; Q50 options A and C read the same in the photo. Q31 and Q50-60 each print their own question, kept as its direction. Q75 and Q76 follow the direction for Q61-74 in form, but no printed direction covers them.
